label: TypeScript Full-stack
cardNote: 🧩 One language across interface, service, and data
headline: TypeScript across the whole product,
from the interface to the API and data model.
summary: In TypeScript projects, I pay close attention to the gaps between frontend, backend, and data, because that is where many expensive bugs begin. I use types, validation, and tests so a change in one part does not quietly break another.

freelance: Built web applications, Node.js services, and desktop and mobile software with TypeScript.
Designed APIs and data models, configured builds, and debugged runtime problems; I also use coding agents under tests and code review.
security: Applied security experience to input validation, authorization, dependencies, secrets, and the boundary between browser and backend.
Wrote repeatable test cases for security issues and checked fixes in both code and project configuration.
company: Worked on distributed mobile and web applications with NoSQL databases and took part in their design and delivery.
Maintained APIs shared by several clients and kept data-model and service-contract changes coordinated across them.
